saknades_roset.beskrivning: A wayside cairn where the Remnant carved the names of those who never came back. Fresh flowers appear every morning, and no one knows who brings them.
saknades_roset.text: The names are many. One is newly carved, and the stone chips still lie on the ground.

jaktkojan.beskrivning: A hunting lodge whose door was broken open from the inside. Tally marks on the wall count days, then stop.
jaktkojan.text: Forty-one marks. The last is only half drawn.

stenbron.beskrivning: An old bridge with rune marks in the arch. Half of it lies in the brook. The marks resemble those on the runestones.
stenbron.text: The same hand that carved the runestones carved this bridge. Someone has chiselled one mark away.

kolarkojan_middag.namn: The Hut with the Laid Table
kolarkojan_middag.beskrivning: Four plates, a pot, a chair knocked over. The food looks warm but is not.
kolarkojan_middag.text: Four plates. Three have been eaten from.

tjardalen.beskrivning: An abandoned tar pit where black tar still seeps. Animal tracks go around it, never across.
tjardalen.text: The tar is warm. Beneath the surface something gleams like bone.

brunnen.namn: The Well at the Burnt Farm
brunnen.beskrivning: The farm's well survived the fire. At night a lullaby rises from below.
brunnen.text: The lullaby stops when you lean over the edge. Then it starts again, further down.

skinnstallningarna.beskrivning: Rows of wolf hides stretched thirty winters ago. Some still have shining claws.
skinnstallningarna.text: One hide is grey and far larger than the others. No one has dared take it down.

likbararnas_bar.beskrivning: A bier of spruce poles left in the middle of the clearing. Its lantern still burns.
likbararnas_bar.text: The bier is empty. The lantern has never needed filling.

vargringen.vad: Wolves howl in a ring around the runestones but never step between them. When a rune wakes, the howling falls silent that night.

ugglan_som_raknar.vad: An owl hoots as many times as there are living souls in the camp. The count rises as the camp's hope grows.

backen_som_tystnar.vad: The brook stops babbling for a few seconds. Everything in the ravine stands still, even the mist. Then all goes on as before.

kojan_dukad.vad: The supper in the hut is laid again in every new game, with four plates. Whoever takes the food gets dried meat.

milan_som_pyr.vad: One kiln has smouldered for thirty years. If the hero adds timber, it lights up the whole Kiln Heath for a night and the camp sees the smoke.

askregnet.vad: Ash falls like snow over the South Heath for an hour. Footprints in the ash lead south and end in the middle of the field.

klockan_i_natten.vad: Wolfstead's church bell strikes three times at midnight, though its rope is cut. Once Ulvhild has fallen, it never rings again.

den_stilla_processionen.vad: Lanterns move in a line across the clearing towards Barrow Ridge. Those who follow find only the barrows and a lantern going out.
